## Requirements (R-2.11.4⁰ᵇ — §7.4, C0/Stage-1 slice per §9)

Stage-1 verb set (per §7.4 §9's Stage-1 row): `hello`; `open_session`
(new|resume|attach), `close`; `submit`, `cancel`, `respond_permission`;
`stream_events`, `read`, `head`, `project(context_view|run_summary|
checkpoint)`, `account`, `describe`; Group L signatures + `run_kind`
data contract. Every other 2.2 verb is declared in the schema at
`experimental` tier with an `AssumptionDebtRecord` (ADR-0178 D4) and a
`stage_pending` marker — reachable before its stage is a build failure.

1. I1 single schema source — `hh-embed-schema` extended (never a second
   source); every wire type/handshake/frame/error defined once; the
   JSON-schema-style export derives from the same definitions; codegen
   consumes only the export.
2. I2 unknown non-`ext` fields refused `UnknownField{path}` at decode;
   `HostCapabilities.extensions`/`ext` slots preserved byte-for-byte.
3. I3 `hello` typed negotiation: `ContractMajorUnsupported`,
   `SchemaMismatch{direction}`, `KernelBelowFloor`; exact pinning.
4. I4 `durable` frames are canonical `EventEnvelope`s hash-equal to the
   ledger at their `seq`; `closed{reason}`, `sync`, `ephemeral`,
   `item_started`, `item_aborted`, `lagged` per 2.4 rules R-1…R-7.
5. I5 injection refusals at the schema: `HookResult{allow}` unexpressible,
   `SecretInPayload`, `EnvHandleId`/`HandleId` unreachable, cap-widening
   override → `AuthorityViolation{layer}`, attach `respond_permission` →
   `CapabilityNotDeclared`, `OptionNotOffered`, `UnknownPermission`,
   `AlreadyDecided`; no `decided{decider: human}` without a pending upcall.
6. I6 `submit`/`respond_permission`/`open_session` carry
   `idempotency_key`; duplicates return the recorded result.
7. I7 no live objects — every handle type stays kernel-side;
   `describe` returns `connection_info/health/meters` only.
8. I8 binding parity — in-process (a) and stdio (b) expose the identical
   verb/frame/error set; byte-identical canonical envelopes in the
   conformance diff.
9. I9 native attachment — `observability_level = ledger`,
   `lifecycle.session.attached/detached`, `embedding{client, binding,
   contract_identity}` + `protocol_bindings[]` manifest facts.
10. `open_session(new)` runs `resolve → validate_assembly → seal`
    kernel-side (host document `human(author)` until `seal`), provisions
    the environment (local_host at Stage 1), opens the run with the
    writer lease, echoes `RealizedSettings`; `resume` =
    `acquire_writer{takeover|continue}` (concurrent →
    `WouldBlock(active_holder)`); `attach` = read-only, no lease.
11. `submit` injects work through the control driver (react/minimal
    boundary); `Accepted{turn_id}` on acceptance; completion is the
    durable `lifecycle.turn.finished`; `cancel` → `Acknowledged` +
    `stop_reason = cancelled`; `respond_permission` lands
    `security.permission.decided` on a live `pending` (the effect
    continuation is DF-S1.23-1/S2.6).
12. Streams: `stream_events(from_seq)` inclusive → `sync` first, durable
    gap-free, ephemeral never seq'd, `lagged{dropped:{ephemeral:n}}`,
    `closed{slow_consumer}` past the bound; writer never stalls.
13. Connection bounds (OQ-402 MUST-data, values from the S0.3 M-S2
    measurements): durable-backlog bound 1024 (= `SUB_BUFFER`), ephemeral
    per-connection buffer 256 eldest-dropped counted into `lagged`,
    in-flight session cap 64 per connection, `cancel_deadline_ms` echoed
    from the armed envelope policy.
14. Stability map in export + `hello.stability`; `experimental` opt-in
    (`list_leases`/`grant`/`revoke_lease` are the Stage-1 experimental
    implementations per §7.4 Group W); `lifecycle.contract.deprecated_use`
    append on deprecated use; compatibility fixtures.
15. Group L signatures: the §7.4 Group L operation records declared as
    schema entries at `experimental` tier (Stage-3 executables per §9 —
    opted-in calls return `Refused{reason: "stage_pending"}`), `run_kind`
    declared in `OpenSpec`.

## Test matrix → implementation
- `crates/hh-embed-schema/src/lib.rs` (+ `ops.rs`, `types.rs`,
  `errors.rs`): the single schema source — full op registry, all message
  types, Frame sum, EmbedError closed sum, HostCapabilities, OpenSpec,
  stability map with `AssumptionDebtRecord`s, strict decoders.
- `crates/hh-embed/`: the binding-neutral contract service —
  `service.rs` (op dispatch), `session.rs`, `runtime.rs` (open_session
  new/resume/attach), `ports.rs` (KernelSink/ModelPort/EffectGate/
  AssemblerPort over Store/Dispatcher/gateway/EnvDriver), `frames.rs`,
  `inprocess.rs` (binding a), `conformance.rs` (fixture cells + byte-diff).
- `crates/hh-codegen/src/emit.rs`: emit all types/sums + typed client.
- `crates/hh-kernel/src/serve.rs`: stdio binding (b) over the service.
- Tests beside each unit + `crates/hh-embed/tests/conformance.rs` and
  `crates/hh-kernel/tests/` for the (b) path.

## Design notes (ticket-owned decisions → ADRs at closeout)
- D1: Stage-1 verb set per §9; remaining verbs `experimental` +
  `stage_pending` (a verb reachable before its stage = build failure).
- D2: `respond_permission` → `security.permission.decided` on the live
  `pending` fold (S2.6 owns the effect continuation — DF-S1.23-1).
- D3: turn path = `hh_control::Driver` (react/minimal) over the real
  `hh_ledger::Store`; `ModelPort` = deterministic Stage-1 scripted port
  emitting real `model.stream.delta` ephemerals; `EffectGate` = real
  `hh_env::Dispatcher` over `EnvDriver`(local_host) + `LocalExecutor`.
- D4: `open_session(new)` = parse → `resolve` → `validate_assembly` →
  `seal` → provision `local_host` → `open_run` → arm driver.
- D5: `stream_events` = `Store::subscribe` replay + live tail through a
  per-connection bounded buffer implementing the 2.4 R-1 semantics.
- D6: `KernelBelowFloor`/`SchemaMismatch{direction}`/negotiated
  `HostCapabilities` at `hello`; session state per connection.

## Self-review / gap analysis

Reviewed the diff end-to-end (hh-embed-schema schema+codecs, hh-embed
service/open/work/runtime/stdio/frames/inject, hh-control driver scope
stamp, hh-kernel serve+tests, codegen emit, generated artifacts).

Landed honestly:
- One dispatch path: binding (b) `hh_embed::stdio::serve` is a framing
  layer over `EmbedService::handle`; binding (a) calls `handle` directly —
  `binding_a_and_b_are_byte_identical` diffs canonical response bytes.
- The driver runs the real `hh_control::Driver<ReactMinimal>` over the
  real `hh_ledger::Store` under the fenced writer lease — no shadow loop.
  `KernelSink` stamps kernel provenance on bare driver rows (the
  provenance-mandatory classes refuse bare appends).
- `lifecycle.run.finished` is minted run-scope (no `turn_id`) — the
  driver previously stamped `turn-1` on every row and tripped the
  ledger's `ScopeNotOpen` gate after `turn.finished` closed the scope
  (fixed in `hh-control::driver::append`; the driver unit suite used an
  in-memory sink and never saw the scope gate).
- `submit.input` mints the registered `context.artefact.delivered` row;
  `security.permission.decided` carries declared fields
  (`permission_id, proposal, decision, decider`) — no invented class,
  no undeclared audit member.
- Resume: `continue` → `WouldBlock` while the writer lives; `takeover`
  releases + re-acquires (generation bumps, audited) and carries the
  fenced session's live driver + ask/idempotency tables into the new
  session — the leaf continues, no `turn-1` re-mint.
- `get_artifact` is content-addressed only: blob addresses via
  `Store::get_blob`; sealed-definition `version_id`s via the
  `sealed_defs` table populated at open — served bytes hash back to the
  requested address.

Known gaps (all deferred, none silent):
- `DefinitionInput::Ref` → `UnresolvedRef` (no publish path) — DF-S1.25-1.
- Resume without a live driver → `Refused{resume_checkpoint_unavailable}`
  (no durable leaf checkpoint) — DF-S1.25-2.
- `sealed_defs` is in-memory (artifacts sealed in a prior service
  lifetime → `Missing{Gc}` → `Refused`) — DF-S1.25-3.
- `stage_pending` verbs are declared `experimental` and refuse
  `Refused{stage_pending}` by the op table — per D1.
- The scripted Stage-1 model port (`EmbedModel`/`EmbedGate`) is honestly
  bounded: `hh.submit` completes; declared host-executor surfaces defer
  `unknown{awaiting_host}` and ride `upcall.invoke_host_capability`;
  anything else refuses `surface_not_bound`.
